762100101.text: #Your technique is truly extraordinary, {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}.

762100103.text: #In that case, I wonder if this {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine} might demonstrate the true essence of <color=#00E1FFFF>Leaping Techniques</color> for me?

762100104.text: According to the records, the ancient masters of my sect, the Guhua Clan, could scale city walls as if they were walking on flat ground. Having truly mastered the art of roof-running and wall-scaling, they distilled these skills into the Leaping Techniques.

762100108.text: #Hmm... We might as well give it a shot. You've done plenty of climbing around looking for treasure anyway, haven't you, {NICKNAME}?

762100107.text: #Hehe, come to think of it, {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}. If a thief can skip over a wall to escape justice, but we who uphold it cannot, wouldn't that leave us powerless to stop the wicked from slipping away?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the person in the painting

762100617.text: With a swift leap, the figure from the painting lands right in front of you...

762100601.text: #Greetings. I'm Zhangsun Jijing. It's an honor to meet you in person, {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}. {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}, may I ask why you have called out to me? Do you have urgent matters to discuss?

762100602.text: Uh, nothing like that. We just saw you hopping all over the place inside the painting and got a bit curious...

762100603.text: Ah, I see. I was merely practicing my lightfoot techniques. That said, I'm afraid I've treated you to a rather poor display.

762100605.text: Indeed. You see, since rain never falls in this realm, I'm unable to practice the "Rain Cutter" arts passed down by my master. Not wishing to let my skills wither from neglect, I've resorted to training in this manner instead.

762100606.text: I often think of those bygone days, when the Great Master Guhua honed his agility upon these very stone piles, eventually reaching the pinnacle of his art. We juniors are of meager talent, yet we strive to imitate even a fraction of his brilliance, hoping for the slightest bit of progress.

762100607.text: #{M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}, since fate has brought us together today, and seeing as you are a fellow practitioner of martial mastery... might I ask you to enlighten me with your skills?

762100610.text: Whoa! Why are you speaking so weirdly all of a sudden? Anyway, uh, what exactly are we supposed to do?

762100614.text: My thanks. In that case, if I may have your attention...

762100612.text: Ah! So I stand before the master of the Paimon Clan, Paimon herself? Forgive my ignorance.

762100613.text: Geez. Do you even hear yourself? Also, since when does the master do all the heavy lifting first?

762100301.text: Have a look at this — our "Plumwatcher Piles," the pride of Guhua.

762100302.text: May I ask you to step on the stone piles in the order I specify within the allotted time, thus demonstrating your prowess?

762100304.text: Though there sure are a lot of "parks" to walk across... Uh, never mind.

762100307.text: #Well then, {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}, it's time to display your prowess.

762100306.text: What!? That's impossible, no matter how you... Wait. Paimon probably could... but flying would be cheating, right?

subQuests.subQuestName: Stand atop the Plumwatcher Piles and show off your moves
Leap onto the roof to display your skills

762100202.text: #That being the case... I have one more humble request. I wonder... Have you, {M#Young Hero}{F#Young Heroine}, heard of the <color=#00E1FFFF>Cloud-Striding Techniques</color>?

762100203.text: Rumor has it that our Grandmaster, Guhua, once ascended the heavens amidst a purple haze, treading upon the very air as if it were solid ground — all made possible by none other than this legendary secret art...

762100205.text: Yeah, sounds like some real hogwash... But come to think of it, could we pull off something similar by using a Wind Glider?

762100207.text: Oh? Then might I ask you to show me a thing or two?

subQuests.subQuestName: Find some way to show off your chops in mid-air

762100502.text: #One could not call that "treading upon air," but you have inspired me all the same. My thanks for your guidance, {M#fine sir}{F#young heroine}.
